style.backgroundSystem: seamless pure white #FFFFFF for packshot and spec screens, pale mint-green info panel #EFF6E3 for infographic and macro screens, vivid chartreuse field #7FBE3C for the benefit and closing screens, warm natural wood #B4844F and sunlit orchard green for scene and detail screens
style.direction: fresh green-heart kiwifruit e-commerce, fresh-picked and appetizing
style.iconSystem: thin-line icons only, single leaf-green accent color
style.lightingSystem: bright soft daylight-style diffused lighting with a top-front key light, gentle fill and soft natural contact shadows; glistening moist flesh and visible fine skin fuzz, never plastic-looking
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh green-heart kiwifruit e-commerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of clean white #FFFFFF, pale mint-green info panel #EFF6E3, vivid chartreuse #7FBE3C, deep leaf-green text #2F6B2A and warm natural wood #B4844F; bright soft daylight-style diffused lighting with a top-front key light, gentle fill and soft natural contact shadows, glistening moist flesh and visible fine skin fuzz, never plastic-looking; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep leaf-green; consistent rounded rectangular info labels; consistent thin-line icon style; clean high-end fresh-produce photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable slight 3/4 hero product angle with the cut face always turned toward the camera; every frame composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles, no plastic-looking fruit rendering.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle for whole fruit with the fuzzy skin readable; whenever a fruit is halved the cut face always turns toward the camera; the whole fruit and the halved cross-section are paired at a fixed scale ratio across the set
style.surfaceSystem: white glazed ceramic plate, warm natural wood plank #B4844F, round woven bamboo board, pale mint-green matte paper #EFF6E3
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif headlines in deep leaf-green #2F6B2A, labels 10-14pt, warm wood brown #B4844F reserved for natural surface tones
